in_marathi.name: Puttu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Puttu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Tamil word 'puttu' which means rice cake. This name is commonly used for children born during the Pongal festival which celebrates the harvest and is traditionally marked by the preparation and consumption of puttu.
